title: The Evian Accords end the Algerian War
summary: France and the Algerian provisional government signed agreements at Evian-les-Bains, providing a ceasefire and a vote on independence.
reason: After eight years of war, de Gaulle decided France could not keep Algeria.
significance: Algeria became independent in July 1962, and about a million settlers left.
participants: Provisional Government of the Algerian Republic
